name: Modern Motion
description: Rules for award-site motion without real-time 3D: scroll choreography, animated heroes, glow depth, and 21st.dev-grade component craft.

rules.instruction: Build the hero as an animated centerpiece with a sequenced entrance: headline, subline, and CTA land in order with eased stagger, backed by an ambient background layer.
Use scroll-driven motion on at least two sections (text reveals, parallax, pinned choreography, horizontal scroll, or tickers); every scroll effect must scrub smoothly with the scroll position.
Use exactly one motion engine (GSAP, Framer Motion/motion.dev, or Motion One) consistently across the project and provide a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
Create perceived depth through layered parallax, perspective transforms, tilt-on-hover cards, or glow effects; never fake depth with a static image where interaction is promised.
Give at least five interactive surfaces real pointer states: tilt cards, shimmer buttons, dock navigation, marquees, text reveals, number tickers, or spotlight effects.
